text:
The years that were lost are here, now.

The dreams I have lived grow between my hands.

I feel how so many days and beings have passed,

so many things by my side without my seeing them.

But suddenly everything returns and gathers in memory,

and so many lives

in a single desire today I have found.

translation.title: In a Single Desire
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the long recovery of years into one present desire.
